input_messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to make some changes.
I don’t remember the email, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187.
First, I want to change the shipping address for that order. I want it sent to my New York address—the same one you have on file from my other order.
I don’t have the address handy, but it should be the same one used for my other order—the one with the air purifier and speaker. Can you just use that?

That’s odd. I’m sure I used my New York address for one of them. Anyway, I’ll look for it later. For now, I also want to change one of the watches—the silicone one. I want it to be a metal watch instead. If there are color options, I’d like white.

Yes, that’s right—switch the silicone, blue dial watch to the metal, white dial one. Use the card you have on file for any difference. 

Also, about my other order—the one with the air purifier and speaker—I want to change the purifier to the large size, with night mode, but still with the HEPA filter. Can you do that?
Yes, that’s all correct. Just change the purifier to large, night mode, HEPA filter, and use the same card for any extra cost. That’s everything I need changed.
Great, thanks for handling that. That’s all I needed.###STOP###
